name: health_probe
sql: CREATE TABLE health_probe ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, checked_at INTEGER NOT NULL ) STRICT

name: push_subscriptions
sql: CREATE TABLE push_subscriptions ( endpoint TEXT PRIMARY KEY, read_id TEXT NOT NULL, subscription TEXT NOT NULL , preferences TEXT NULL, preferences_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0) STRICT

name: snapshots
sql: CREATE TABLE snapshots ( read_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, payload TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL ) STRICT

name: usage_reports
sql: CREATE TABLE usage_reports ( read_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, seq INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, payload TEXT NULL ) STRICT
